title: Smoked American Skewers
description: A twist on traditional skewers, using smoked American ingredients for a vegan option that's both flavorful and nutritious.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Add the mushrooms, sweet potatoes, bell peppers, and onion. Toss to coat.
Thread the skewer with the marinated vegetables, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the vegetables are tender and lightly charred.
Serve hot with a side of marinara sauce for dipping.
